findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma for an arbitrary branch index `k : Fin 3`, e.g. in CubicThetaPrimeCubeBranchCoordinates.lean or CubicThetaHorizontalSection.lean, wherever both imports are available:

```lean
lemma cubicThetaPrimeCubeBranchPoint_horizontal {p : Eisenstein} (hp : primaryPrime p)
    (k : Fin 3) (b : Eisenstein) (v : ℝ) (hv : 0<v) (z : ℂ) (w : ℝ) (hw : 0<w) (y : ℂ)
    (hy : (p:ℂ)^k.val/(p:ℂ)^(3-k.val)*z+3*(b:ℂ)/(p:ℂ)^(3-k.val)=y)
    (hwv : ‖(p:ℂ)‖^k.val/‖(p:ℂ)‖^(3-k.val)*v=w) :
    cubicThetaPrimeCubeBranchPoint hp k b (cubicThetaHorizontalPoint v hv z)=
      cubicThetaHorizontalPoint w hw y
```

Proof sketch: `apply Subtype.ext; apply Prod.ext`. For the first coordinate, use `change` to get the unfolded form `(p:ℂ)^k.val/… * z + ((3*b:Eisenstein):ℂ)/… = y`, then `push_cast`, rewrite the `3` cast with `map_ofNat eisensteinRing.subtype 3` (the same step as now), and finish with `exact hy`. For the second coordinate, `exact hwv`.

Both branch lemmas then contain only their own algebra:
- Bottom: `:= cubicThetaPrimeCubeBranchPoint_horizontal hp 0 b v hv z _ _ _ (by field_simp [hpC]) (by field_simp [hn])`. Here `hpC` and `hn` are obtained as they are now; because `y` contains `((p^3:Eisenstein):ℂ)`, the first side goal may need `push_cast` first.
- First branch: `:= cubicThetaPrimeCubeBranchPoint_horizontal hp 1 b v hv z _ _ _ (by field_simp [hpC]) (by field_simp [hn])`.

The statements of both lemmas, and all their downstream uses, stay the same.
findings.benefit: The cast of `3*b` and the Subtype/Prod steps that link `cubicThetaPrimeCubeBranchPoint` to `cubicThetaHorizontalPoint` would live in one place. If the branch-point definition or the cast API changes, only one proof needs fixing. Each branch lemma would show just its algebraic content (`v/‖p‖^3` and `(z+3b)/p^3`, or `v/‖p‖` and `z/p+3b/p^2`), so it is easier to read. A future k = 2 horizontal-mean file could use the same helper instead of a third copy.
